dialogue_texts: Oof... okay! I give! Your gaps are a lot scarier than the first frost!
A wise choice. Now, point me toward the mansion near Yumemura.
The air is becoming positively suffocating.
Just follow the trail where the maples turn from gold to blood-red.　But be careful, eh?
The "glohm" is thicker there—it's like the world is closing its eyes.
Closing its eyes? Then it's a good thing I brought my own sight.
Try to keep your leaves tidy while I'm gone.
